20:00 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: NHL Hockey
The Carolina Hurricanes battle the Boston Bruins in NHL regular-season action at Lenovo Center. The Hurricanes have won three of the last five meetings between these sides, including a 6-5 overtime win at Lenovo Center last April.
